sources.title: minimax-h3-spatial-physics-lora: Text-to-Video model — overview, use ...
sources.snippet: Overview minimax-h3-spatial-physics-lora is a LoRA adapter for MiniMax-H3 trained to improve physics-based motion and spatial relationships in video generation, particularly for object collisions, stacking, rolling, and momentum transfer. Created by Jojocodex, this adapter uses Rank 16 architecture at 512 resolution trained on 90 frames at 24fps across public physics reasoning datasets ...

sources.title: GitHub - MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-H3
sources.snippet: MiniMax H3 is a general-purpose, omni-modal generative system. It supports unified understanding of multimodal contexts composed of text, images, video, and audio, and can generate video with native stereo audio at resolutions up to 2K and durations of up to 15 seconds.
